question: The number of oscillations per second is called _______ of oscillation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**frequency**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Frequency is the number of oscillations or cycles per second in an oscillating system.
 
• It is measured in Hertz (Hz), where one Hertz is equivalent to one cycle per second.
 
• Frequency is a fundamental parameter in various fields, including physics, engineering, and telecommunications.
